description: Configuration values for the Chainguard EBS CSI driver add-on

additionalProperties.description: Node settings for one extra DaemonSet

additionalArgs.description: Extra command-line arguments for the driver container of this entry's pods. An empty list replaces node.additionalArgs too.

affinity.description: Affinity of this entry's pods. It merges over node.affinity key by key at every level; an empty map does not override it.

daemonSetAnnotations.description: Annotations on this entry's DaemonSets. It merges over node.daemonSetAnnotations key by key at every level; an empty map does not override it.

dnsConfig.description: DNS configuration of this entry's pods. It merges over node.dnsConfig key by key at every level; an empty map does not override it.

enableLinux.description: Create the Linux DaemonSet for this entry. It replaces node.enableLinux, which defaults to true.

enableMetrics.description: Serve metrics from this entry's pods. It replaces node.enableMetrics. The chart creates no metrics Service for these pods, because the node metrics Service follows node.enableMetrics and selects only the ebs-csi-node pods.

enableWindows.description: Create the Windows DaemonSet for this entry. It replaces node.enableWindows, which defaults to true.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the driver container of this entry's pods, as Kubernetes EnvVar objects. An empty list replaces node.env too.

hostNetwork.description: Run this entry's pods on the host network. It replaces node.hostNetwork.

kubeletPath.description: Kubelet root directory on the nodes, which this entry's pods mount from the host: an absolute path with no .. element. It replaces node.kubeletPath.

legacyXFS.description: Format XFS volumes with bigtime=0,inobtcount=0,reflink=0 so that nodes with Linux kernel 5.4 or older can mount them. Such volumes record timestamps only until 2038. Upstream plans to remove this setting. It replaces node.legacyXFS.

logLevel.description: Log verbosity of the driver container of this entry's pods. 0 replaces node.logLevel too.

loggingFormat.description: Log format of the driver container of this entry's pods

metadataSources.description: Comma-separated metadata sources that replace the driver's default. Valid sources are imds (the EC2 instance metadata service), kubernetes, and metadata-labeler (alpha). An empty string replaces node.metadataSources too.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector of this entry's pods, added to the operating system selector of each DaemonSet. It merges over node.nodeSelector key by key at every level; an empty map does not override it.

otelTracing.description: OpenTelemetry tracing for this entry's pods. Setting it turns tracing on. It merges over node.otelTracing key by key at every level; an empty map does not override it.

otelExporterEndpoint.description: OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP) endpoint that receives the traces (OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT). An empty string replaces node.otelTracing.otelExporterEndpoint too.

otelServiceName.description: Service name reported in the traces (OTEL_SERVICE_NAME). An empty string replaces node.otelTracing.otelServiceName too.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations on this entry's pods. It merges over node.podAnnotations key by key at every level; an empty map does not override it.

podLabels.description: Labels on this entry's pods. It merges over node.podLabels key by key at every level; an empty map does not override it. Rejects the keys app, app.kubernetes.io/name, and app.kubernetes.io/instance, which the chart's selectors use, and app.kubernetes.io/managed-by, app.kubernetes.io/component, app.kubernetes.io/version, and helm.sh/chart, which the chart sets itself.

priorityClassName.description: PriorityClass of this entry's pods. When unset, the pods use system-node-critical. An empty string replaces node.priorityClassName too.

reservedVolumeAttachments.description: Number of attachment slots to reserve for system use rather than CSI volumes. When unset or -1, the driver estimates it. Cannot be set together with volumeAttachLimit. 0 replaces node.reservedVolumeAttachments too.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits of the driver container of this entry's pods. It merges over node.resources key by key at every level; an empty map does not override it.

revisionHistoryLimit.description: Number of old revisions that each of this entry's DaemonSets keeps. 0 replaces node.revisionHistoryLimit too.

selinux.description: Turn on SELinux-only optimizations in this entry's pods. Set it only if every Linux node in the DaemonSet has SELinux enabled. It replaces node.selinux.

serviceAccount.description: Service account settings that apply to this entry's pods

disableMutation.description: Turn off the taint watcher in this entry's pods. It replaces node.serviceAccount.disableMutation. The node service account's permissions follow node.serviceAccount.disableMutation.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Seconds to wait before a stopping node pod is forcefully terminated. 0 replaces node.terminationGracePeriodSeconds too.

tolerateAllTaints.description: Let this entry's pods tolerate every taint. It replaces node.tolerateAllTaints, which defaults to true. Set it to false to use this entry's tolerations.

tolerations.description: Tolerations of this entry's pods, used only when tolerateAllTaints is false for this entry, set here or taken from node. An empty list replaces node.tolerations too.

volumeAttachLimit.description: Maximum number of volumes that can be attached to each node. Cannot be set together with reservedVolumeAttachments. 0 replaces node.volumeAttachLimit too.

additionalDaemonSets.description: Extra node DaemonSets, keyed by a name that becomes part of the DaemonSet names (ebs-csi-node-<name> and ebs-csi-node-<name>-windows): lowercase letters, digits, - and ., at most 50 characters, not windows and not ending in -windows. Each entry takes node settings and merges over node: maps merge key by key at every level, a setting that the entry leaves out or sets to an empty map keeps its value from node, and any other value replaces it, including false, 0, an empty string, and an empty list. Null is rejected, because it deletes the value from node.

batching.description: Batch EC2 API calls. Improves performance in workloads that are sensitive to EC2 rate limits.

extraVolumeTags.description: Tags added to every EBS volume that the driver creates. The chart passes them to the driver as one comma-separated list of key=value pairs, so a key cannot contain , or = and a value cannot contain ,. A key cannot start or end with a space, because the driver trims it. The driver refuses to start with the keys CSIVolumeName and CSIVolumeSnapshotName, or a key that starts with kubernetes.io or ebs.csi.aws.com/, so those are rejected too.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations on the controller pods. The chart runs each key and value through Helm's tpl function, so keys must be Kubernetes annotation keys with a lowercase prefix, other than the deprecated AppArmor and seccomp keys, and values must be strings with no {{ and no control characters other than tab and line feed, integers from -999999 to 999999, or booleans.

enabled.description: Create a PodDisruptionBudget that keeps at least one controller pod able to attach, detach, create, and delete volumes. Turning it off can delay stateful workloads while controller pods restart or are evicted.

maxUnavailable.description: Maximum number or percentage of controller pods that may be unavailable. Set this or minAvailable, not both. With neither set, the budget allows 1 unavailable pod for 2 or fewer replicas and requires 2 available pods otherwise. To set 0, pass the string "0": the chart ignores the integer 0 and uses that default.

minAvailable.description: Minimum number or percentage of controller pods that must stay available. Set this or maxUnavailable, not both. With neither set, the budget allows 1 unavailable pod for 2 or fewer replicas and requires 2 available pods otherwise. To set 0, pass the string "0": the chart ignores the integer 0 and uses that default.

unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy.description: Unhealthy pod eviction policy of the PodDisruptionBudget, IfHealthyBudget or AlwaysAllow
